_comment: All spoken / on-screen text lives here. Keys are referenced from map objects (property 'dialogue') and scenes.

signs.move:
ARROWS: WALK
HOLD SHIFT: RUN
UP: JUMP

intro.text: That's me! Here for the big interview.
Wonderful. Your desk is at the back. Log in so I can tell the team you're here!

login.label: ENTER YOUR E-MAIL TO LOG IN
login.privacyLocal:
PRIVATE: STAYS ON THIS
DEVICE. CLEAR IT ANY TIME
IN PAUSE > RESET.

world1.text: Collect the 10 gold coins. Each one tells you a fact about {name}!
Jump on bugs to squash them. Touching one costs coins and sends you back to the last checkpoint.

world2.text: Finish each classroom task to earn a degree and open the gate.
Collect books, stomp bugs, pull the lever. There is no timer.

world3.text: One floor per job. Beat the floor boss to reveal a real achievement.
Stomp a boss three times. It gets faster after every hit!

world4.text: Skill coins come in four colours. Fill all four skill bars at the bottom.
Pipes lead to bonus rooms (press DOWN). Hold SHIFT + UP for a long jump.

world5.text: Walk under a ? block and jump to bump it. Certificates pop out!
Printer Jams shoot paper: stomp them or time your run. The trophy hall waits at the end.

world6.text: The rooftop at sunset. Stand by a terminal and press ENTER to get in touch.
Run to the HIRE ME flag at the end to finish the game.
